summary: Calidi Biotherapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering a direct registered offering of 1,025,640 common shares at $1.17 per share to accredited investors and/or qualified institutional buyers under a September 17, 2026 securities purchase agreement, equal to the September 16, 2026 NYSE American close of $1.17. No underwriter, placement agent, or discounts apply; proceeds are available immediately with no escrow. The supplement amends a prior at-the-market prospectus (Ladenburg Thalmann), under which $9.9 million was previously sold. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
